text:
incident-bot: Pager: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/generate — elevated 5xx and timeouts after recent deploy. Triggered rule: p99 > 2s for 3m.
ops_jane: paging SRE. p95 ~ 900ms -> p99 ~ 6.2s after deploy ~12m ago. 502/504 + upstream timeouts. Rolling deploy id d-20260317-11.
sre_lead: ack — taking it. Gathering traces & flamegraphs. @eng_miguel @alice can you join?
eng_miguel: on it. I triggered canary at 12:13 and then full rollout at 12:18. Checking rollout logs and healthchecks now.
alice: graphs show KV cache eviction spikes and host-level queue length jump on eu-west-1 workers. tail latency matches the deploy window.
ben-oncall: mitigation suggestion: divert new traffic off the canary, shift 30% to stable route, enable model-variant fallback. Can ops apply route shift?
ops_jane: applying route shift now — moving 35% away from the new pool to stable.
ops_jane: quick metric update: error rate dropping from 7.8% -> 3.4% in last 60s; p99 fell to ~1.1s but p95 still ~650ms.
eng_miguel: looking at connection stacks — keepalive setting bumped in the new image (60s -> 30s) combined with proxy ephemeral-port reuse caused connection churn. Some workers exhausted conn pool, requests queued.
sre_lead: if we can't stabilize in 10m recommend rollback. We need customer impact assessment in parallel.
eng_miguel: initiating rollback of d-20260317-11 now (rollback command: deploy rollback --id d-20260317-11).
incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by eng_miguel for d-20260317-11 — estimated completion 120s.
alice: post-rollback metrics: p99 down to 220ms, 5xx back to baseline ~0.5%. KV eviction normalized.
customer-success: logging affected accounts and notifying support to prepare proactive outreach for any customers who reported errors.
ops_jane: leaving notes for the night oncall: https://dash.redwood/incident/5998765432 and troubleshooting checklist + mitigation steps. Handoff in 30m.
eng_miguel: created follow-up INF ticket INF-3421: investigate keepalive defaults + kube-proxy port exhaustion on GPU nodes, add a canary invariant for connection churn.
sre_lead: closing immediate pager — monitoring for 15m. If anything reoccurs, re-open. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
summary: Deploy d-20260317-11 caused keepalive/conn-pool churn leading to p99 timeouts; traffic shift + rollback mitigated; follow-up ticket INF-3421 created.
